title: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py: Out-of-bounds channel index for plans with fewer than 3 channels
description:
The select_channel algorithm uses `n = max(num_channels - 1, 2)` then returns `1 + (h % n)`. For a 2-channel plan, this returns indices 1 or 2, but only indices 0-1 are valid. For a 1-channel plan, returns 1 or 2 when only 0 is valid. Subsequent calls to frequency(index) will raise ValueError.

Fix suggestion: Change the formula to handle small channel plans: `n = max(num_channels, 1); return h % n` if all channels should be selectable, or add validation that rejects plans with fewer than 3 channels if channel 0 must remain reserved.
